_about: Yae Asato (141153, psychic_gal): translated from the game's Japanese, keeping her gyaru slang. Global names/terms: Yae Asato, Yuki Mishima, Shota Inori (Shou), Yukariko Kuguri (Yukarii), Magia Fest, Aegis, the Starsayers, Parfait, Palpebra, Starview Village.
profile: Yae Asato. A 16-year-old first-year high school student. A psychic of freedom. Searching for something she can lose herself in, she drifts around as a carefree adventurer while sightseeing in other worlds. She's sociable, and her sense of personal space with others is close in every sense.
titleCondition: Level Yae Asato to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

1.title: The Unbound Girl
1.summary: While guarding a caravan headed for Shibuya, Alk and the others meet Yae Asato, a girl in the same high school uniform as them. Yae gushes that she's wanted to talk to Stella and the others ever since Magia Fest. After a trip to the ocean world together, Alk and the others gladly show her to Starview Village.

lines.9: This cargo's headed for Shibuya, right? We'll come along while we're at it. There might be more trouble.

2.title: The Breathing Room We Want to Protect
2.summary: With their work finished early and nothing to do at the shelter, Alk and the others are escorted around town by Yae. As they hang out, they get a feel for Shibuya's recovery and a glimpse into Yae's past. After hearing her wishes for Shibuya, they head back out into the city, a little wistful.

lines.5: Oh, it's you guys. Heyy, good work. What's up, you working? Want me to help with something?
lines.9: Hey, it's fine, it's fine. We just finished.
lines.12: ...If anything, we finished too fast. We've got nothing planned, so we were just talking about what to do.
lines.16: ...Hey, Asato. Is it really okay to fly around in a skirt?? I don't think it's a good idea, y'know? Just saying???

lines.26: No, it's NOT fine for us!!
lines.40: That sort of thing is not allowed...!

lines.48: I won't do it again, so forgive me★ I don't wanna get killed by Yukarii either~
lines.54: Huh... What? You're friends with Yukarii too??
lines.58: Hm? Yup? She's so cute it's scary~!

lines.78: As thanks for taking me to the ocean the other day, today I'll be your escort~!

3.title: Untangling Anxiety
3.summary: Unable to answer a nightmare she hadn't seen in a long time, Yae is brought even lower by cruel words from someone she thought was a friend. But moved by a shop owner working hard not to lose to her, Yae finds a firm answer when the nightmare returns.

lines.182: And she did some sales pitching while shopping. Said she found a few shops she might be able to deal with. Isn't that wild? So cool.
lines.185: I was super nervous, my heart was pounding~. But I can't lose to Yae!

lines.203: Huh!? Wait, what's wrong!? Why are you suddenly crying!?
lines.216: Do things freely, and then what?
lines.218: There's nothing I want badly enough to push others aside for it.
lines.222: ...Yeah. That's why I wanna find it.
lines.225: Talk to all kinds of people, see all kinds of worlds. I wanna find my very own sparkle.
lines.236: In this world, I'm gonna fly as far as I can go--!

1141153/1.19:
Yae Asato. A 16-year-old first-year high school student. A psychic of freedom.

Searching for something she can lose herself in, she drifts around as a carefree adventurer while sightseeing in other worlds. She's sociable, and her sense of personal space with others is close in every sense.

5000623/1.19: The most prestigious girls' school in the Shibuya area. Known as an exclusive school for the daughters of prestigious families and the wealthy, it covers elementary through high school, so students can normally move straight up from one level to the next.

5000623/2.19: However, as a private school, Hizakura's high tuition means most of its students come from wealthy families. Some students, like Yae Asato, the psychic of freedom, couldn't continue on because of their parents' finances and transferred to other schools.
